issue_context.title: Postgres primary key issue
issue_context.body:
Hello,

if my primary key column is not named 'id' then the created sequence in the postgres db has a hardcoded dependency on the column name (it is created as 'nextval("tableName"_id_seq:reqclass'
This makes the column marked as not generated and in subsequent restarts it tries to recreate it

review_comments: can you please use camelCase in property names in this, others and future models, its its more natural to use camelCase in js world.
Sure, I did it this way since this is how I discovered the issue. So instead of using different database names in the decorator, I chose to take the class as is in my code
